The existing callers can keep using the constructor unchanged because the options will be variadic.

item.text: The implementation now accepts options without loading AWS defaults when an IMDS client is injected, which makes custom endpoints usable directly. I removed the direct HTTP probe; its first test invocation caught the now-unused HTTP import, which I’ve removed. I’m rerunning the package tests and reviewing the final diff.

item.text:
Updated [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go:109) with functional client options and `WithIMDSClient`. `IsAvailable` now retrieves `instance-id` through IMDS with a 250 ms timeout and accepts only IDs matching the EC2 format.

`go test ./lib/utils` and the EC2 labels package passed. The service package build was blocked by missing host headers and SQLite C symbols (`linux/hidraw.h`, `pread64`, `off64_t`).
